EmailTemplate.name: SAL SLA Expired
EmailTemplate.subject: MQL has not been Contacted.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead you own {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} in the SAL Stage, needs to be contacted. An activity (Email or Phone Call) must be logged within 2 business days after moving to the SAL Stage. Please attempt to contact {!Lead.Name} and log the activity. Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
Leads move to a terminated state if there is no activity for 30 days and 90 days since the creation date.
Thank you.
